Sustain the Failing

You kneel beside your companion and hold out your hand. Strength passes into their injured body, leaving you pale and breathing hard.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One willing creature within 3 squares, including self

Moser’s law of conservation of Life energy: pay 3 HP before rolling; bypass resistance and remain above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces restoration, minimum 1 where HP is missing. Healing-harmed creatures take the rolled result as Life damage. No resurrection or removal of wounds/Grit loss.

- Weak: Restore 5 HP. - Standard: Restore 10 HP. - Strong: Restore 15 HP and reduce temporary Poisoned by 1.

Duration: Instant

Equipment / acquisition: None.

---

Tier / minimum level: 3 · DP: 4 · Requirements to learn: Life 2

Type: Magic / Recovery

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: sustain-the-failing

@UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0bf4c8ad89113132.JournalEntryPage.c0c043f22d65aa20]{Card conventions} · Catalog

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
